source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 1Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed interim statements from p.4 (auditor PwC). Thousand Baht. SCI p.7. Revenue and expenses 22.1 (p.44, printed sideways, read turned -90; columns non-PAA / PAA / total, 3 months, both years): incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward 17.1.2 p.33 (3 months; the full-year 2568 table on p.34 is not extracted); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business 17.1.3 p.35: no total column; the onerous column is nil, so the non-onerous column is the total. Other revenue = อื่นๆ (22.1). RA release uses 22.1 (201,695), not the AOC RA (201,906). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
